$description: Form, FormSection, FormActions (platform/patterns/Form), library wave 6, lane B: the space between a form's sections and inside them. The fields are Fields in a Stack; the actions are an ActionBar.

form-gap.$description: Form: the space between its sections, and above its actions.

form-section-gap.$description: Form section: the space between its header and its fields.

form-section-header-gap.$description: Form section: the space between its title and its description.

form-two-column-grid-template-columns.$description: Two-column form: the label column every section shares (the inline field's label column) and the control column (the inline field's range, as in a Stack of inline fields).
